_comment: The News tab. One entry per day, newest first, written once a day by the scheduled task 'WoW Forever daily news (gear planner)'. Sections in this order when they have items: 'Game' (hotfixes, patch notes, fixed quests, announcements), 'WoWSims' (changes to the simulator). Nothing about this site's own changes. Every item is written in the planner's own words, one or two sentences, with the link it came from; never copied text. Entries older than 60 days are dropped.

entries.summary: WoWSims made the Druid dungeon set bonuses work in the simulator.

items.title: Wildheart and Feralheart set bonuses work
items.text: The Druid dungeon sets now restore energy on swings and rage when struck in the simulator, and the Wildheart 5-piece bonus is no longer marked as partly implemented.

items.title: Random suffix items pick their best suffix
items.text: A change named "random suffix best EP" was merged: going by its name, the simulator can now pick the suffix worth the most for a build.
